headline: NYY @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.15 at TOR 2.98, with a projected total of 7.14. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (NYY -0.27, TOR -0.14), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.40, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Ernie Clement, Nathan Lukes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Daulton Varsho because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
